avr_zones.label: Control AV receiver zones
avr_zones.description: Show each zone of a multi-zone Denon/Marantz AV receiver as its own speaker, with its own power, volume and mute, using the receiver's HTTP control interface. A receiver has a single HEOS stream, so every zone that is on and set to HEOS hears what any of them plays.

ip_address.label: Main controller hostname or IP address.
ip_address.description: Hostname or IP address of the HEOS device to be used as the main controller. It is recommended to use a wired device as the main controller.

playback_transition_timeout.label: Playback transition window
playback_transition_timeout.description: Time in seconds to ignore stale HEOS metadata updates after Music Assistant starts playback. Increase this for players that take longer to switch to the new stream.

timeout.label: Command timeout value
timeout.description: Set the timeout value to use when sending commands to the HEOS system. Some devices could reply slower to commands, if you are seeing Command timeout logs, try increasing this value.

manifest.description: Play to Denon & Marantz devices via HEOS.
